text:
Iris: Quick announce — RapidCall (v1.0) is GA on Hosted API. Focused on super-low TTFB for short tool-backed responses and safer pre-commit partials. Opt-in from Console > Endpoints now. :tada:

Devon: Love it. Is this meant to replace any existing streaming modes?

Iris: Not immediately. RapidCall is complementary but will become the recommended path for tool-heavy latency-sensitive flows. We will deprecate `shortstream` in 80 days. Migration helpers will be provided.

Kai: Ops note — starting with a 12h canary in region-us-east-1. I added a canary checklist and a synthetic that validates partial commits and tool coherence.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rollout/rapidcall-ga: canary started (us-east-1) at 2932109885, replicas=3.

Devon: SDK changes or breaking surface area for customers?

Iris: Minor SDK patches only. New endpoint `/v1/rapidcall/stream`. New param `precommit=true|false` (defaults false). When `precommit=true` customers can receive verified partials earlier. JS/Py helpers expose `on_precommit` callback.

Devon: Example snippet for docs?

Iris: Short curl for release notes:

Iris: ```bash
Iris: curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
Iris:   -d '{"model":"rapid-sm-1","precommit":true,"tool_calls":true}' \
Iris:   https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rapidcall/stream
Iris: ```

docs-bot: docs-bot: docs/rapidcall-ga published at https://console.redwood.ai/docs/rapidcall — includes migration guide and quota details.

Kai: Monitoring additions: precommit success rate, partial-to-final delta, and tool-safety checks. Alerts if precommit success <98% in canary.

Devon: Billing / quotas? Any new limits to call out?

Iris: Rapid units billing = tokens + precommit_frames. Default quota: 30 streaming rps per key for RapidCall, precommit frames capped at 2000/min. Customers can request increases via Console.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rollout/rapidcall-ga: canary health=ok (2932109930). Scheduling broader rollout in 3 hours pending metrics.

Kai: I'll post the support playbook and host a 20-min walkthrough for CS at 3pm PT.

Iris: Thanks team — watch #eng-runtime for regressions and tag me for escalations. Town hall tomorrow 10am PT to demo precommit flows. :rocket:
